body: The sentence "Verify that user-uploaded files - if required to be displayed or **downloaded by the application** - are served by either octet stream downloads, or from an unrelated domain, such as a cloud file storage bucket." seems to indicate the file is downloaded by the application, but I think the intention is to say "displayed or downloaded from the application".
title: V1.12.2 - Change "downloaded by" to "downloaded from"
